verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party capability for scheduling arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows. Stripe Billing's automated recurring payments are a domain-specific subscription feature, not a general workflow scheduler. The Kyber app is a third-party, event-triggered (not scheduled) automation. The catalog-import cadence is only a recommendation that the user must schedule externally.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
